title: Dissipative spin-boson model and Kondo effect in low dimensional quantum gases
abstract: We show that ultracold atoms confined in a quasi-1d trap can be used to study the dissipative spin-boson model with {\it tunable} tunneling splitting and strength of dissipation. It is shown that with realistic parameters this system allows to study the crossover from coherent Rabi dynamics to incoherent tunneling.
